source: Figma file Design MCP › Layouts page. The brand team keeps adding references: page breakers, closing slides, fixed slides (product stack, team) and content-slide layouts.
rule: Keep each reference slide's layout and decoration as designed. A slide with an html field ships as ready HTML: the hero slides (page breaker, closing) as a decoration-only backdrop from Figma with the text in data-slot elements to fill with the user's words; the fixed slides (team, product stack) as the Figma render of the whole slide, with nothing to fill. Use the snippet as it is. For the others, map only: background colour to the theme token, fonts to the nearest text style (14–72px), chips to the chip tokens, and the logo to its design-system placement. For content references, Claude may adapt the layout to the content, still mapping these four.

mapping.background: theme background token (background/brand, background/inverse or background/primary)
mapping.fonts: nearest named text style, never below 14px or above 72px (Display/XL)
mapping.chips: container/inverse + text/inverse, radius/md, padding spacing/8 × spacing/12, Body/XL Semi Bold, case as written (uppercase optional)
mapping.logo: top-right on the 52px edge; white on dark and brand, blue on light; size may vary

product_stack.figma: 13 · Harness — every capability exposed to agents
product_stack.use: Whenever the product stack or platform slide is asked for, place its ready HTML (html) as it is: the Figma render of the slide, with nothing to fill or change.

team.use: The Faclon Labs leadership team: whenever the user asks for the team or about-Faclon slide, place its ready HTML (html) as it is, with nothing to fill or change. Not for a project team (the people on one proposal): design that from the user content (content form people), with headshots from the asset library where they exist.

page_breaker.use: Page breakers and Q&A slides: place the ready HTML (html), the brand team mapping of 17806942 (Reference Slides for QnA), and fill only its data-slot elements (label, title, optional proof strip). More designs will be added.

closing.figma: 29 · Close — every factory will run on AI
closing.use: One of the closing designs; more will be added. Ships as ready HTML (html): place it as it is and fill only its data-slot elements (tag, statement) with the user's words; never redraw the backdrop or move the text.

content.figma: content layouts on the Layouts page (e.g. 14 · knowledge flywheel, 20 · customer journey, 23/24 · GTM, 26 · plan)
content.use: Starting points for normal content slides; more will be added.

kinds.fixed: product stack, team — used as designed whenever asked for
kinds.hero: page breakers and closing slides — pick one of the designs
kinds.content: layouts for normal content slides — a starting point Claude adapts to the user's content
